clue.text: Firm suffering setback staying in previous position

indicators.note: something staying in a place sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: late means former or previous, as in the late chairman

indicators.note: a setback turns things back, so the word for firm is read backwards

parts.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A business in trouble clings to its former standing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firm' looks like the definition but supplies the abbreviation; the definition is 'position', used as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To position something is to place or site it, the verb sense of the answer.

clue.text: Being left in debt sounds familiar in the countryside

definitions.note: a noun phrase for the noise cattle make in fields

parts.note: someone in debt is owing money

explanation.surface: A debtor who has been abandoned hears comfortingly rustic noises.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep mooing of cattle is a noise heard everywhere on farms.

clue.text: Limit prisoner, showing no liberal tendency

parts.note: a con is slang for a convict, a prisoner
someone who is not liberal or lenient is strict

explanation.surface: A harsh regime restricts an inmate's freedoms.
explanation.definitionFit: To constrict is to squeeze or restrict, a synonym of limit as a verb.

clue.text: Savings account is something worth having set up

indicators.note: in a down entry, set up means written upwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: an asset is a thing of value, something worth having

explanation.surface: A bank account is described as a worthwhile possession.
explanation.walkthrough: TESSA was a Tax-Exempt Special Savings Account, a British savings scheme of the 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is the acronym of a tax-free British deposit scheme for savers.

clue.text: Publicist came across as anything but superficial

parts.note: a PRO is a public relations officer, a publicist
to come across something is to find it, past tense found

explanation.surface: A PR person was perceived as deep rather than shallow.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deep and penetrating is the opposite of shallow or surface-level.

clue.text: Fluid capacity is mentioned

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: room is space or capacity, as in room for six

explanation.surface: Someone states how much liquid a container holds.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheum is a watery discharge from the eyes or nose, a bodily fluid.

clue.text: Nosy enthusiast swapping lids one's used in the kitchen

indicators.note: the lids are the tops of the two words, their first letters, which change places

parts.note: a nosy person is prying
a fan is an enthusiast

explanation.surface: An inquisitive admirer exchanges covers on pots while cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swapping lids' exchanges the first letters of PRYING FAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A shallow pan for cooking food in hot fat is standard kitchen equipment.

clue.text: American takes time to establish tradition

parts.note: US stands for the United States, so American
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: An American takes a while to set up a custom.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is established custom or practice, as is tradition.

clue.text: Choppers to be taken out?

parts.note: choppers is slang for teeth; these are false ones, which can be removed from the mouth at night

explanation.surface: Helicopters or axes being brought out for use.
explanation.definitionFit: False teeth are a set of artificial choppers that can be removed.

clue.text: Woman created policy

parts.note: made means created
a line is a policy, as in the party line

explanation.surface: A woman devised a course of action.
explanation.definitionFit: Madeline is a girl's name, so it names a woman.

clue.text: It's calm at one end of this old nuclear site

definitions.text: It's calm at one end of this
definitions.meaning: the Beaufort scale of wind force runs from calm at 0 to hurricane at 12
the former name of the Sellafield nuclear plant in Cumbria, England

explanation.surface: A former atomic plant is described as peaceful at its edge.
explanation.walkthrough: Windscale, renamed Sellafield in 1981, is the Cumbrian nuclear site of the 1957 fire.
explanation.definitionFit: One reading is the measure of wind strength, the other the old name of a nuclear plant.

clue.text: Long story about the end of Rome

indicators.note: one piece goes about, or around, the other

parts.note: a yarn is a story or tale

indicators.note: the last letter of the word Rome is taken

explanation.surface: A lengthy tale concerning the fall of Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something is to yearn, both verbs of strong desire.

clue.text: Egg — consider added salt

parts.note: a nit is the egg of a louse
to rate is to consider or judge, as in I rate him highly

explanation.surface: A recipe note: think about adding some seasoning to the egg.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitrate is a salt of nitric acid, used in fertilisers and preserving.

clue.text: Fellow with the unlined gold cloak

parts.note: a man is a fellow

indicators.note: the inside, or lining, of the little word is removed, leaving its outer letters

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A man wears a gold cape that has no lining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unlined' strips the middle letter H from THE, leaving TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A manteau is an old word for a loose cloak or mantle.

clue.text: It's dusk when the churchwarden may come out

definitions.text: It's dusk when the churchwarden may come out

parts.words: It's dusk when the churchwarden may come out
parts.note: a churchwarden is also a long clay tobacco pipe, which may be brought out and lit; dusk is also when vehicles must switch on lamps

explanation.surface: A church official appears at nightfall.
explanation.walkthrough: A churchwarden is a long-stemmed clay pipe as well as a parish officer.
explanation.definitionFit: The official hour after sunset when road vehicles must show lights.

clue.text: Random alternatives offered by Juke Box Jury panel?

definitions.text: alternatives offered by Juke Box Jury panel?
definitions.meaning: Juke Box Jury was a BBC TV show of the 1960s where a celebrity panel voted each new record a success or a flop

explanation.surface: A TV panel gives haphazard verdicts on records.
explanation.walkthrough: On Juke Box Jury panellists judged new pop singles, ringing a bell for a hit and a hooter for a miss.
explanation.definitionFit: Haphazard and unplanned is the adjectival sense; the two verdicts are the literal one.

clue.text: Old brig unsuitable to house a prisoner

indicators.note: to house something is to hold it inside, so one piece contains the other
unsuitable suggests the letters are not right as they stand and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: An ancient sailing ship is no place to keep a convict.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsuitable' rearranges OLDBRIG to GOLBIRD, and 'to house' puts A inside it after the G.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaolbird is a habitual criminal, someone often in prison.

clue.text: Bad-tempered bishop interrupts Roman pair on board

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: II is two in Roman numerals
RR stands for Right Reverend, the title of a bishop
a table is a board, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: A grumpy cleric breaks up two Romans sitting at a table.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritable means easily annoyed, short-tempered.

clue.text: Vegetable, say — good place for insect to burrow under

indicators.note: in a down entry the insect goes under the preceding pieces, coming after them

parts.note: EG is short for for example, signalled by say
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A good spot for a bug to dig into a vegetable, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggplant is the American name for the aubergine, a vegetable.

clue.text: Call an election and visit a rural constituency?

definitions.meaning: the idiom for a government seeking a fresh mandate from voters
literally travelling out of town to farmland

explanation.surface: A prime minister calls a poll and campaigns in a farming seat.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to dissolve parliament and hold a general election; literally, a trip to rural parts.

clue.text: Vessel that is in the Gulf

parts.note: a can is a container, a vessel
yon is an old or dialect word for that, as in yon hill

explanation.surface: A ship is somewhere in the Persian Gulf.
explanation.definitionFit: A canyon is a deep gorge, a chasm or gulf in the land.

clue.text: Look around in foreign capital to find a star

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other

parts.note: Paris is the capital of France, a foreign capital to a British setter

indicators.note: around turns the little word for look the other way

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look, as in lo and behold

explanation.surface: A tourist searches a foreign city to spot a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Look' is the old exclamation, as in lo and behold, not a verb meaning gaze.
explanation.definitionFit: Polaris, the Pole Star, is a star in Ursa Minor.

clue.text: Girl wants ring — something to catch beast liable to run off

definitions.text: something to catch beast liable to run off

parts.note: a lass is a girl
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A young woman wants an engagement ring, and something to catch a wayward animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A lasso is a looped rope thrown to catch straying cattle or horses.

clue.text: Offer of cheap goods, including black fur

indicators.note: one piece includes, or holds, the other

parts.note: a sale is an event offering goods cheaply
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A bargain sale has black furs among its stock.
explanation.definitionFit: Sable is the valuable dark pelt of a small Asian marten.

clue.text: Ornate tile in Catholic church maybe

definitions.text: Ornate tile in Catholic church maybe

parts.words: Ornate tile in Catholic church maybe
parts.note: tile is old slang for a hat; this one is the stiff square cap worn by Roman Catholic clergy

explanation.surface: A decorative floor tile in a Catholic church.
explanation.walkthrough: Tile looks like a floor or roof tile, but it is slang for a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A biretta is a square cap with ridges worn by Catholic priests, a hat.

clue.text: Woman carrying coal-scuttle in middle of pram

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other
the middle letters of the word pram are taken

parts.note: a hod is a coal-scuttle

explanation.surface: A mother pushes a pram holding a coal bucket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Woman' at the front is the definition; the rest builds her name.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhoda is a girl's name, so it names a woman.

clue.text: Very short attack

indicators.note: short means cut off before the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to assail is to attack

explanation.surface: A very brief assault.
explanation.walkthrough: ASSAI is the musical term for very, as in allegro assai.
explanation.definitionFit: Assai is the Italian musical direction meaning very, used with tempo marks.

clue.text: Street vendor — a Lancashire lad?

definitions.meaning: a trader selling fruit or goods from a handcart in the street
a lad from Barrow-in-Furness, historically a Lancashire town

explanation.surface: A northern boy sells goods on the street.
explanation.walkthrough: Barrow-in-Furness was in Lancashire before 1974; now it is in Cumbria.
explanation.definitionFit: A street trader with a cart is the usual sense; the other is a local lad.

clue.text: Ill-gotten gains brought back and dumped in outhouse

parts.note: loot is stolen goods, ill-gotten gains
to shed is to cast off or dump

explanation.surface: Stolen goods are returned and stashed in a garden building.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool shed is a small outbuilding for garden implements, an outhouse.

clue.text: What's to be found in milk container at home

definitions.text: What's to be found in milk

parts.note: a case is a container
in means at home

explanation.surface: Someone asks what is in the milk carton at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Casein is the main protein in milk, used to make cheese.
